text: Yes, the 2021 loss was entirely within the pine plantation. The MGAP 2021 forest map shows that 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha lost was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), with only 13.2 ha outside mapped forest—likely small gaps or edges. The asset is a planted forest context, so the loss aligns with the plantation boundary. No native forest was affected.
